metadata.scenario: A dissatisfied customer calls to complain about the poor quality of the recent home cleaning service. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Michael Brown. I'm calling about a service issue we had recently. I’m sorry to hear that, Michael. Can you tell me what happened? Well, we had a home cleaning service scheduled for my father, and it was really disappointing. They didn’t clean properly at all. I apologize for that, Michael. That must be very frustrating for you and your father. Yes, it was. They left dust in the corners, and the bathrooms were not cleaned. I understand your concern. That’s not the level of service we strive for. Exactly. This was supposed to help him, not add more stress. Let’s address this immediately. Can I get some details about when the service occurred? It was last Friday. We were really hoping for a better experience. Thank you for that info. I will escalate this issue to our Client Services Manager right away. I appreciate that. I just want to make sure this doesn’t happen again. Absolutely, Michael. We value your feedback. Can I take your father’s name for follow-up? His name is Henry Brown. Can you ensure that someone will follow up with me? Yes, I will personally ensure you receive a follow-up call by tomorrow. Thank you. I really hope this gets resolved quickly. We’ll do our best, Michael. Also, I want to mention that we offer skilled nursing and medication management services. Oh, my father needs medication management too. He has diabetes. That’s great to hear. We can set up a consultation for that service as well. Yes, I’d like that. Can you provide more details? Certainly! Our medication management service is between $65 and $80 for a 30 to 45-minute visit. That sounds reasonable. Can you also check if he needs wound care? Yes, we offer wound care management at $75 to $95. Perfect. I’ll take both. Wonderful! I’ll arrange for someone to contact you regarding setting up the services. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help today. You’re welcome, Michael. We’ll be in touch soon to follow up on the cleaning complaint and your father’s care. Sounds good. Have a great day. You too, Michael. Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health!
